name: Container Memory Usage vs Limit (GB)
programText:
(data('container_memory_working_set_bytes', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'connect-0')) / 1024/1024/1024).publish(label='Usage')
(data('kube_pod_container_resource_limits', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'connect-0') and filter('resource', 'memory') and filter('container', 'connect')) / 1024/1024/1024).publish(label='Limit')
